assessment: The authors assess the psychometric properties of behavioral, psychophysiological, and brain imaging measures of fear conditioning. Six-month retest reliability was generally low, whereas internal-consistency reliability was generally high. At the group level, reliability and criterion validity were generally good. Most measurements proved sensitive to data analytical choices. Results are framed within a larger discussion of the role of measurement properties in individual difference research and clinical translation and have the potential to serve as an important building block towards improvement in both these areas.
